svg.editability: editable mixed vector composition with two approved replaceable raster atoms
svg.structural_summary: Native vector geometry, text, gradients, seven directed arrows, nine path-based equations, and two relative PNG sidecars.

pptx.editability: editable native shapes, text, gradients, vector equation objects, and two independent approved raster picture atoms
pptx.structural_summary: One slide with 82 native shapes, nine vector equation objects, gradients, text, and two bounded picture shapes; equations are not Office Math and arrows are not attached connectors.

drawio.editability: experimental editable structural graph with known rendering limitations
drawio.structural_summary: Editable mxGraph cells, labels, two embedded approved raster atoms, and seven directed topology edges; the frozen file is not claimed to be visually equivalent in the official draw.io CLI renderer.

pdf_preview.editability: preview/export only; not an editable source
pdf_preview.structural_summary: Valid one-page PDF preview/export; its embedded high-frequency raster region is lossy and is not the editable source of record.

known_limitations: The draw.io file is a structurally editable experimental view; the official CLI currently renders major colored regions as black and displays equation labels as raw LaTeX.
PPTX equations are editable as independent vector objects but are not semantically editable Office Math.
The PDF is a preview/export and uses lossy encoding for its embedded raster regions.
